header.subtitle: Hold MSc in Information Systems and looking for Data Engineering opportunities in Switzerland.

myInfo.title: About Me
myInfo.bio1: Data Engineer focused on data systems design, database modeling, and scalable architectures. Proficient in Python, SQL, and AWS for building ingestion pipelines, structuring databases, and orchestrating deployments with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
myInfo.bio2: Academic foundation in Information Systems (MSc, UNIGE), with competence in Artificial Intelligence (Multi-Agent Systems, RAG, Machine Learning) and Knowledge Engineering (Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs).
myInfo.bio3: I am a French-Canadian citizen and a native French speaker, fluent in professional English, with elementary Mandarin. Outside of tech, I'm passionate about cinema and playing competitive poker.

about.msc_title: Master of Science in Information Systems & Knowledge Engineering
about.msc_desc: Relevant Coursework: Information Retrieval, Data Science, Machine Learning, Knowledge Organisation Systems.
about.bsc_title: Bachelor of Science in Information Systems
about.bsc_desc1: Relevant Coursework: Databases, Data structures and Algorithms, Computer Networks, Artificial Intelligence, Enterprise Information Systems, Object-Oriented Programming.
about.bsc_desc2: Completed a thesis focused on the classification and automated correction of programming assignments, integrating knowledge from multiple disciplines.
about.bac_title: Baccalaureate Diploma with Honors in Science, with Mathematics Specialization
about.ta_desc1: Mentored first-year Bachelor's students in an Introduction to Programming course; facilitated practical sessions, debugged Scala code, and simplified Object-Oriented Programming, data structures, and File I/O concepts.
about.ta_desc2: Contributed to enhancements for the course's JupyterHub environment as part of a team, managing version control with Git and containerizing dependencies using Docker to ensure reproducible student workspaces.
about.ta_desc3: Engineered an automated testing and personalized feedback pipeline using Python and nbgrader to dynamically evaluate assignments based on unit tests, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate contextual hints and explanations.
about.intern_school: Division of Buildings Management DIBAT, University of Geneva
about.intern_desc1: Conceptual, logical, and physical modeling (in 3NF) and creation of a relational database in MariaDB to centralize building energy records.
about.intern_desc2: Development of data ingestion pipelines (ELT) in Python (using requests) for extraction from external REST APIs and Excel files, and optimized loading via SQL queries.
about.intern_desc3: Direct collaboration with non-technical stakeholders to translate business requirements into data models, and development of an interactive visualization interface (HTML/JS) powered by REST APIs (Flask).
about.intern_desc4: Containerization of the database infrastructure and API with Docker, and implementation of CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions for automated deployment on a Linux VPS.
about.vol_desc1: Engaged in social work by teaching seniors about computers and various software applications.
about.vol_desc2: Conducted volunteer sessions to enhance their digital literacy, focusing on practical and accessible technology skills.
